calls.title: Design Check-in
calls.summary: The meeting centered around the organization of design components and workflows to enhance clarity amid complexity, led by Kari Kay. Key points included the importance of consistent cover components for tracking design progress across various release stages, the necessity for better file naming and organization to minimize confusion, and the application of standardized annotations for clear communication. Additionally, challenges with usability in panel components and feature variations due to engineering complexities were discussed. An emphasis on accommodating non-technical users highlighted a strategic shift towards improving experimentation tools. The group acknowledged the importance of dark and light mode testing and the reliance on informal feedback methods like Slack, which may hinder effective communication.
calls.keywords: design system, components, annotations, experimentation, dark mode, user experience
